editorial.blurb: A nostalgic Korean BBQ hideaway that transports you straight to Seoul with authentic meats, attentive service, and an all-you-can-eat experience that won't quit.
editorial.insiderTip: Go late night or arrive around noon for a quieter, more relaxed atmosphere—and definitely opt for the all-you-can-eat option to maximize the quality meat selection like chadolbaegi, samgyeopsal, and prime brisket.
